definitions.explanation: The creative direction and staging of a theatrical production, film, or event.
Special effects or theatrical touches added for impact.

examples.japanese: {演出|えんしゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was a play with wonderful direction.

notes:
COMPOUND: {演|えん} (perform) + {出|しゅつ} (produce, put out)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演出|えんしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to direct, to produce)
- ⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}{家|か}→演出家：15916_enshutsuka⟧ (director, producer)
- ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧{演出|えんしゅつ} (stage direction)
- ⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧{演出|えんしゅつ} (lighting effects)
- ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{演出|えんしゅつ} (flashy production)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {演出|えんしゅつ} - artistic direction (how to present)
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ - overall director (film/TV)
- ⟦{脚本|きゃくほん}→脚本：04459_kyakuhon⟧ - script (what to say)

USAGE:
Can describe any creative presentation, not just theater:
- ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演出|えんしゅつ} (wedding presentation/effects)
- ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{演出|えんしゅつ} (event production)
